summary: Regression check for BonusTab.js extraction from AdminPage.js. Static lint immediately flagged TWO CRITICAL missing imports in /app/frontend/src/components/admin/BonusTab.js: 'Textarea' (used at line 463 — programs editor 'Краткое/Расширенное описание' fields and prize descriptions) and 'Switch' (used at line 946 — prize 'Активен' toggle). Testing agent FIXED both by adding `import { Textarea } from '../ui/textarea'` and `import { Switch } from '../ui/switch'`. Without these, opening the program editor dialog or the prizes section would throw 'ReferenceError: Textarea is not defined / Switch is not defined' and crash the bonus tab. After fix, complete UI regression of the Бонусы tab passes: tab renders, programs list shows, new+edit dialogs open with all fields including Textarea/Switch, Ozon settings save returns success toast, program user list expands, points (Начислить/Списать) modal opens, prize redemptions render. Zero pageerrors, zero console errors observed.

ui_bugs.issue: Two critical undefined identifiers in extracted component: line 463 used <Textarea /> and line 946 used <Switch /> but neither was imported (these were imported in AdminPage.js but not carried over during extraction). Would cause 'ReferenceError: Textarea/Switch is not defined' at runtime as soon as the program editor opens, crashing the bonus tab. Fixed by adding `import { Textarea } from '../ui/textarea';` and `import { Switch } from '../ui/switch';`.

action_items: (Already fixed by testing agent) Add `import { Textarea } from '../ui/textarea';` and `import { Switch } from '../ui/switch';` to BonusTab.js. Main agent should keep these imports.

When extracting further admin tabs from AdminPage.js, run `eslint --rule 'react/jsx-no-undef:error'` on the new component before considering the refactor complete. This would have caught both Textarea and Switch immediately.

Pre-existing react/no-unescaped-entities warnings at BonusTab.js:609:83 and 609:102 (double quotes in JSX text) — not runtime errors, can be addressed by replacing literal `"` with `"` or wrapping in {}.
critical_code_review_comments: Verbatim JSX extractions must include a static-import audit of every identifier used inside the new component. The previous BonusTab extraction missed two ui-library imports because the original AdminPage.js imported them at the top; mechanical copy of JSX doesn't bring along the import lines. A simple eslint --max-warnings 0 in CI would prevent this regression class entirely.

BonusTab.js still receives ~20 props as a flat prop drilling list from AdminPage.js. Consider grouping into 2-3 objects (e.g., bonusState, bonusHandlers) or moving state into the BonusTab component itself with a useBonusAdmin hook. Future tab extractions will benefit from the same cleanup.

The points dialog title currently says 'Списать баллы' when triggered from the minus button — verify the symmetric add-points flow via the '+ Начислить' button also opens with title 'Начислить баллы' (logic dependent on pointsModal.type).

context_for_next_testing_agent: BonusTab.js was extracted from AdminPage.js verbatim. Testing agent fixed two missing imports (Textarea, Switch). If main agent extracts more admin tabs the same way (CRMTab, OrdersTab, etc. are already in /app/frontend/src/components/admin/), run `mcp_lint_javascript` on each new file to catch jsx-no-undef before testing. All bonus admin flows confirmed working: Ozon save, list, new/edit program dialog, expand users, points modal, redemptions.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: during the verbatim JSX extraction of the bonus tab from AdminPage.js into BonusTab.js, only ~9 imports were carried over (axios, motion, lucide icons, Button, Input, Label, Dialog parts, TabsContent, toast). Two additional shadcn-ui components used inside the JSX — Textarea (program description fields & prize descriptions) and Switch (prize 'Активен' toggle) — were left out because the developer copied JSX in isolation without scanning identifier usage. Reproduction (pre-fix): login as admin → /admin?tab=bonus → click 'Добавить программу' or the pencil edit icon → React render throws 'ReferenceError: Textarea is not defined' inside <DialogContent>, dialog never appears and the bonus tab shows a white React error overlay. Mitigation applied: added the two missing imports from '../ui/textarea' and '../ui/switch'. Long-term: enforce ESLint react/jsx-no-undef as error in CI; or refactor with a codemod that auto-rewrites import lines based on actually-used JSX components.
